comment: What the operator reaches by reflection beyond what NativeImageFeature registers (every class of fabric8's core, common and coordination models, and the Cutover resource) and what acemq-infra-rabbitmq's own file registers (the admin client's model, repeated here harmlessly).

Recorded, not written: GraalVM's tracing agent ran the JVM operator through the whole of scripts/operator-e2e.sh on kind -- plan, approve, apply, rollback, a pod killed mid-drain, a deleted Cutover's journal kept and adopted, the Secret and allowlist refusals -- and this is its output with the Feature's classes removed. Most of it is the JDK's TLS and fabric8 resolving every KubernetesResource its ServiceLoader names; the rest is JOSDK instantiating its default retry and rate limiter, and the fabric8 client building itself.

To record it again after a dependency changes: build Dockerfile.agent (the JVM image on a GraalVM JDK with the agent on), run ./scripts/operator-e2e.sh --keep --no-build with E2E_OPERATOR_IMAGE naming it, kubectl cp /tmp/agent out of the operator pod, and drop the entries NativeImageFeature covers. Then the e2e with --native is the check that nothing is missing.
